primaryBuildRule: Every installed primary combat technology is at the population TL. Every legal build is filled to the selected Hull capacity. Unmodeled residual capacity is recorded as zero-tactical-effect mission AUX space rather than left empty.

missionAuxFiller.interpretation: Harness accounting only. Represents useful mission/logistics/support installations not yet numerically executable; it is not a new game component and carries no combat benefit in CP111.

geometry.preContactSearch: one hex toward map center per turn
geometry.note: CP111 intentionally uses one canonical axial geometry to validate instrumentation before expanding to off-axis/system-map geometry populations.
geometry.postContactMovement: If the previous combat track is not Firm and no demonstrated standoff is being preserved, close on later movement decisions instead of holding at nominal physical/preferred range.
geometry.sameHexBurnthroughBaseline: Carry forward the accepted +1 same-hex Burn-through Resistance geometry contribution at every TL in this first pass. No higher-TL burn-through scaling is assumed or promoted by CP111.

internalDamageNote: The repository retains the C# internal-damage/critical model, but CP111 Python ecology combat does not consume it. Shields, Armor, Hull, ammunition, power, sensing/EW, PDS, fuel, movement, and terminal Hull destruction are simulated.

overloadScope.reactorSafeOverload: enabled in the primary ecology when +1 TP materially improves the immediate combat package and safe Strain remains
overloadScope.sensorOverload: zero-weight deterministic Overload-I probe validates TL1 range/power/Strain effect; not activated by the primary ecology doctrine
overloadScope.ecmEccmOverload: zero-weight deterministic Overload-I probes validate rating/power/Strain and ECCM restoration effect; primary ecology uses normal rated EW only
overloadScope.stlOverload: zero-weight deterministic Overload-I probe validates Move/power/fuel/Strain effect; primary ecology uses normal movement only
overloadScope.interpretation: Risky overload probes prove instrumentation and current component-defined effects but have zero inference weight in same-TL balance summaries.

mixedTlPopulation.reason: Keep the first instrumentation/ecology inference population same-TL. Mixed-TL and legacy-component populations will be separate overlays so they cannot contaminate same-TL inference.

blockingGates: all primary builds exactly fill Hull Space after explicit mission-AUX accounting
all TL1-TL9 populations contain all three Main Weapon families
both movement-order mirrors exist for every unordered build pair
required current-mechanic telemetry paths are exercised
nonBlockingReviewSignals: ECM downgrade and ECCM restoration frequency
